findings.issue: Task 4 owns frontend/types/funnel.ts (StepType union + targetFunnelId/targetEntryStepId/endParentAfter fields) and i18n locale files, but its prose repeatedly hedges with 'якщо Task 1 уже їх додав — не дублювати'. Task 1 is backend-only (its Files-to-modify lists no frontend file and the task text never references funnel.ts), so Task 1 will never add these. The hedge is harmless (Task 4 falls through to 'add them') but the cross-reference to a non-existent Task 1 frontend change is misleading and could cause an executor to waste time looking for it. Ownership is in fact unambiguous: Task 4 is the sole owner of funnel.ts and both locale files.
